children: Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) plans to lease $47.3 billion in chips for about five years, with payments due even if equipment fails. A $25.2 billion tranche carries an 8.259% annual yield.
Anthropic is expected to pay SpaceX billions monthly for AI computing capacity. CEO Dario Amodei praised SpaceX’s services but said Anthropic’s future infrastructure mix remains uncertain.
SPCX raised $85.7 billion in its June IPO after underwriters used their overallotment option. Banks earned about $500 million in fees; Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley each received 20.5%.
Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) advanced rocket recovery and reuse over the weekend. CEO Elon Musk also voiced optimism about its data-center expansion and Terafab chip project.
Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla are increasingly aligned and might be better together, reviving merger speculation. He announced no deal.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) will use Nvidia’s Vera CPUs and optimized Vera Rubin system in its planned orbital data centers, including the first-generation Starmind AI satellite.
SpaceX (SPCX) acquired Cursor in August in an all-stock deal valued at about $60 billion. Cursor’s parent, Anysphere, told Congress it may phase out Chinese AI models over geopolitical risks.
SPCX’s IPO prospectus cites a goal of making humanity multi-planetary and outlines longer-term plans for artificial general intelligence and solar-powered data centers in space.
